prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Windows desktop application icon master, square 1024x1024 with genuine transparent background
Primary request: Create a highly simplified original product mark for ‘Modern Emoji Picker’: one deep-indigo rounded square picker tile with exactly four small colourful rounded cells arranged 2x2, where the lower-right cell is a clean coral smiling face; add one small golden four-point sparkle at the upper-right edge. The whole mark must remain unmistakable and crisp at 16px, 20px, 24px and 32px.
Style/medium: minimal polished vector-like icon, flat geometry with very subtle depth, professional utility branding
Composition/framing: centred compact silhouette, generous transparent padding, no speech bubble tail, no large emoji overlapping the tile, no extra symbols
Color palette: deep indigo shell, coral smile cell, cyan and gold secondary cells, white facial details only where needed; high contrast in light and dark environments
Constraints: exactly one outer tile, exactly four inner cells, one smile, one sparkle; no text, no letters, no watermark, no platform emoji artwork, no Windows logo, no gradients that muddy small sizes, no thin lines, no extra confetti or decorative elements, transparent corners
